name: Family-Photo Grouping Workbook
description: Enter names once. Check your chosen family-photo groups. Print a list your photographer can call by name. A macro-free .xlsx planning workbook for couples organizing wedding family photos, with a reusable roster, private pair checks, a separate day-of list, a fictional example, blank A4 and US Letter PDFs, and a setup guide. Up to 60 people, 30 chosen pairs and 40 groups of ten people. Tested in LibreOffice desktop; Google Sheets support is not verified or claimed. Pair flags are advisory; no automatic scheduling or family decisions.

name: Two-Parent Christmas Gift Tracker
description: When two adults split the Christmas shopping, it's easy to lose track of who bought what, and to end up with one child getting more than the others. This workbook keeps one shared list, shows each child's gift count and spending side by side, and flags online orders that might miss the gift date or a return window.
